_note: Design axes and 10-session phased assembly pipeline. The dispatcher assigns one compatible genre+twist+setting per new game and advances each game through phases 1..10 across 10 sequential sessions.
twists: Limited Ammo Must Be Physically Retrieved

1.title: Phase 1/10 — Core Playable Foundation & Signature Mechanic
1.focus: Create the game folder, manifest (`"phase": "1"`), responsive Canvas + ResizeObserver harness, unified InputManager (Keyboard/Mouse + Touch), baseline SaveManager + SoundEngine, and a 100% playable core gameplay loop implementing the Genre x Twist mechanic with initial enemies and scoring.

2.title: Phase 2/10 — Player Mastery, Secondary Tactical Ability & Reactive Vector Rig
2.focus: Deepen player control and physics (`player.js` or expanded player subsystem): add a secondary tactical ability/dash/overdrive skill with cooldown HUD indicator, multi-part procedural player vector sprite with reactive animations (recoil, thrust, aim telegraph, invulnerability blink), and tight collision/momentum tuning. Set `"phase": "2"` in `game.json`.

3.title: Phase 3/10 — Procedural World, Parallax Environment & Interactive Stage Hazards
3.focus: Bring the Axis C visual setting to life (`world.js` or environment subsystem): implement at least 3 animated parallax background layers themed to the setting, plus interactive stage hazards/obstacles (destructible cover, environmental traps, conveyor/gravity zones, or shifting geometry) that dynamically affect both player and enemies. Set `"phase": "3"` in `game.json`.

4.title: Phase 4/10 — Diverse Enemy Roster & AI State Machines
4.focus: Expand enemy variety (`enemies.js` or enemy subsystem) to at least 5 distinct enemy archetypes (e.g. Swarmer, Ranged Sniper, Shielded Bruiser, Splitter/Spawner, Area-Denial Hazard), each with unique procedural vector geometry, pre-attack visual telegraphs, and distinct AI movement behaviors. Set `"phase": "4"` in `game.json`.

5.title: Phase 5/10 — Multi-Phase Boss Encounters & Attack Patterns
5.focus: Implement multi-phase Boss Encounters (`bosses.js` or boss subsystem) triggered every 5th wave (or milestone score): create at least 2 distinct Bosses with animated boss health bars, warning banners, phase transitions at 50% HP, and bespoke attack patterns that challenge the player's Axis B twist. Set `"phase": "5"` in `game.json`.

6.title: Phase 6/10 — Wave Director, In-Run Upgrade Draft & Combo Multipliers
6.focus: Add deep run-to-run progression (`progression.js` or upgrade subsystem): build a between-wave Upgrade/Perk Draft modal (or interactive tactical upgrade choice) offering 3 randomized build upgrades (from a pool of 8+ perks/mutators) when clearing waves, plus physical field pickups and a risk/reward combo multiplier decay bar. Set `"phase": "6"` in `game.json`.

7.title: Phase 7/10 — High-Impact Arcade Juice, Particle Emitters & Combat VFX
7.focus: Maximize visual feedback (`vfx.js` or juice subsystem): add directional particle emitters for hits/thrusters/explosions, hit-stop freeze frames on critical impacts and boss kills, directional screen shake respecting Options intensity, floating combat damage/combo popups with smooth easing, and motion trails/afterimages. Set `"phase": "7"` in `game.json`.

8.title: Phase 8/10 — Multi-Voice Web Audio Synthesizer & Dynamic Adaptive Soundtrack
8.focus: Upgrade `SoundEngine` (`audio.js` or audio subsystem) into a rich procedural Web Audio synthesizer: create a multi-voice procedural background synth/arpeggiator + percussion loop that shifts tempo/filter intensity during Boss waves and low-HP states, plus 10+ distinct synthesized SFX across all weapons, abilities, enemy hits, upgrades, and UI buttons. Set `"phase": "8"` in `game.json`.

9.title: Phase 9/10 — Complete Accessibility, Ergonomic Touch UI & 6 Unlockable Milestones
9.focus: Complete all UI, accessibility, and persistence features (`ui.js` or UI subsystem): verify Master Mute + SFX/Music sliders, Screen Shake (100%/50%/Off), Particle Density (High/Low), working High-Contrast/Colorblind palette mode, live on-screen FPS counter toggle, Touch Controls (Auto/Always/Off + Left/Right handedness swap), Base64 Save Export/Import + 2-step Reset, and 6 earnable Milestones/Badges shown on Title and Game Over screens. Set `"phase": "9"` in `game.json`.

10.title: Phase 10/10 — Final Integration, Balance Tuning, QA Audit & Masterpiece Release
10.focus: Perform the final integration and balance pass across all modules: tune wave pacing, enemy spawn weights, boss HP, and upgrade scaling so early waves are welcoming and late waves are thrilling; add an interactive tutorial/hint overlay on Wave 1; eliminate any runtime edge cases or memory leaks; and set `"phase": "10"` in `game.json` to graduate the game as a finished 10-Session Arcade Masterpiece.
